data.subject: Whatnot's Dublin expansion and close workflows
data.body:
Whatnot opened a new European headquarters in Dublin and announced plans to hire 130 people.

Establishing a European headquarters often creates additional foreign vendor management and multi-entity close workflows.

Zamp builds AI agents that own finance back-office work end to end. For Instacart, we cut AP approval time from 2 weeks to 2 days, and Block removed 75% of human touchpoints in the accounting close.

Are you open to a 20-minute call next week to see how this works?
